zh-CN\u0000精英斧术攻击。命中时造成额外 10…34…40 点伤害，并.text: 精英斧术攻击。命中时造成额外 10…34…40 点伤害，并对另外 1…2…2 名邻近敌人造成 10…34…40 点砍击伤害。

zh-CN\u0000精英鎚术攻击。命中时击倒目标，并使其虚弱 5…17…20.text: 精英鎚术攻击。命中时击倒目标，并使其虚弱 5…17…20 秒。

zh-CN\u0000精英态势。持续 5…17…20 秒，移动速度提高 33%，.text: 精英态势。持续 5…17…20 秒，移动速度提高 33%，攻击获得的怒气加倍。使用任何非怒气技能时，此态势结束。

zh-CN\u0000精英技能。持续 15 秒，每当你用剑攻击时，所有邻近敌人受.text: 精英技能。持续 15 秒，每当你用剑攻击时，所有邻近敌人受到 10…30…35 点砍击伤害。

zh-CN\u0000精英战嚎。音量所及范围内的盟友移除残废病症，并在 5…11.text: 精英战嚎。音量所及范围内的盟友移除残废病症，并在 5…11…13 秒内移动速度提高 33%。

zh-CN\u0000精英宠物攻击。宠物尝试发动凶猛冲击，造成额外 13…25….text: 精英宠物攻击。宠物尝试发动凶猛冲击，造成额外 13…25…28 点伤害。命中时，你获得怒气和 3…9…10 点能量。

zh-CN\u0000精英态势。持续 1…7…8 秒，移动速度提高 33%，并有.text: 精英态势。持续 1…7…8 秒，移动速度提高 33%，并有 75% 几率格挡攻击。

zh-CN\u0000精英弓术攻击。移除你的所有准备技能。向目标及其最多 5 名.text: 精英弓术攻击。移除你的所有准备技能。向目标及其最多 5 名邻近敌人射箭，命中时各造成额外 5…17…20 点伤害。

zh-CN\u0000精英陷阱。触发后持续 2 秒，每秒对附近所有敌人造成 10.text: 精英陷阱。触发后持续 2 秒，每秒对附近所有敌人造成 10…34…40 点穿刺伤害，使其残废 3…21…25 秒并击倒。陷阱在 90 秒后消失；施放时容易被中断。

zh-CN\u0000精英弓术攻击。射出一支飞行速度为普通箭矢两倍的箭。.text: 精英弓术攻击。射出一支飞行速度为普通箭矢两倍的箭。

zh-CN\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 5…15…17 秒，目标盟友无法成为敌.text: 精英加持魔法。持续 5…15…17 秒，目标盟友无法成为敌方法术的目标。

zh-CN\u0000精英咒文。治疗目标盟友 5…81…100 点体力；若该盟友.text: 精英咒文。治疗目标盟友 5…81…100 点体力；若该盟友体力低于 50%，额外治疗 30…98…115 点体力。

zh-CN\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 5…11…13 秒，目标盟友获得 +3.text: 精英加持魔法。持续 5…11…13 秒，目标盟友获得 +3…9…10 体力再生和 20…40…45 点护甲。

zh-CN\u0000精英纹章。击倒目标敌人，并对该目标及其所有邻近敌人造成 1.text: 精英纹章。击倒目标敌人，并对该目标及其所有邻近敌人造成 15…63…75 点神圣伤害。

zh-CN\u0000精英咒文。将盟友的所有病症及其剩余持续时间转移到你身上。.text: 精英咒文。将盟友的所有病症及其剩余持续时间转移到你身上。

zh-CN\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 10 秒，目标其他盟友获得 +3…5….text: 精英加持魔法。持续 10 秒，目标其他盟友获得 +3…5…6 能量再生。

zh-CN\u0000精英降咒。持续 6…25…30 秒，目标及附近所有敌人受到.text: 精英降咒。持续 6…25…30 秒，目标及附近所有敌人受到 −1…3…4 体力衰减，获得的治疗效果降低 25%。

zh-CN\u0000精英纹章。将自身所有负面病症转移给目标敌人，持续时间为各病.text: 精英纹章。将自身所有负面病症转移给目标敌人，持续时间为各病症剩余时间的 100…180…200%。诅咒属性不高于 4 时有 50% 失败几率。

zh-CN\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 20…39…44 秒，区域内盟友免疫疾.text: 精英加持魔法。持续 20…39…44 秒，区域内盟友免疫疾病；以近身攻击击中这些盟友的敌人会患病 3…13…15 秒。

zh-CN\u0000精英咒文。若目标敌人体力高于你，你获得双方体力差的一半（不.text: 精英咒文。若目标敌人体力高于你，你获得双方体力差的一半（不超过你的体力上限），目标失去等量体力。若目标体力低于你，则你失去差值的一半，目标获得等量体力。

zh-CN\u0000精英咒文。目标敌人失去 1…8…10 点能量，每失去 1.text: 精英咒文。目标敌人失去 1…8…10 点能量，每失去 1 点能量，该目标受到 7 点伤害；附近所有其他敌人受到该伤害的 75%。

zh-CN\u0000精英态势。持续 5…17…20 秒，你施放的法术回复速度提.text: 精英态势。持续 5…17…20 秒，你施放的法术回复速度提高 33%。

zh-CN\u0000精英降咒。持续 5…17…20 秒，目标移动和攻击速度降低.text: 精英降咒。持续 5…17…20 秒，目标移动和攻击速度降低 50%，并受到 −1…7…8 体力衰减。

zh-CN\u0000精英咒文。目标敌人失去 2…8…9 点能量，每失去 1 点.text: 精英咒文。目标敌人失去 2…8…9 点能量，每失去 1 点能量，你获得 3 点能量。

zh-CN\u0000精英加持魔法。在 30 秒内使用的下一个技能会替换回音，替.text: 精英加持魔法。在 30 秒内使用的下一个技能会替换回音，替换后的技能持续可用 30 秒。

zh-CN\u0000精英降咒。3 秒后，击倒目标敌人，造成 14…83…100.text: 精英降咒。3 秒后，击倒目标敌人，造成 14…83…100 点闪电伤害，并施加 5…17…20 秒碎甲病症。此法术有 25% 护甲穿透。

zh-CN\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 8…18…20 秒，获得 +20 护甲.text: 精英加持魔法。持续 8…18…20 秒，获得 +20 护甲，无法成为敌方法术的目标；期间无法攻击，且受到 −2 能量衰减。

zh-CN\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 25…53…60 秒，与风、火、水、土.text: 精英加持魔法。持续 25…53…60 秒，与风、火、水、土四系元素调和，这四项属性提高 1…2…2。每次使用这些元素的魔法时，获得 1 点能量，加上该技能基础能量消耗的 50%。

zh-CN\u0000精英咒文。目标及其所有邻近敌人受到 15…51…60 点火.text: 精英咒文。目标及其所有邻近敌人受到 15…51…60 点火焰伤害。若你的能量多于受击敌人，该敌人额外受到 15…51…60 点火焰伤害，并着火 1…8…10 秒。

zh-CN\u0000精英降咒。目标受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害。若你的能.text: 精英降咒。目标受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害。若你的能量高于目标，该目标额外受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害，并在 1…4…5 秒内移动速度降低 90%。

zh-CN\u0000由阿斯卡隆的毁灭出发，追查白斗篷、马赛特与寻火者预言。其他.text: 由阿斯卡隆的毁灭出发，追查白斗篷、马赛特与寻火者预言。其他篇章的角色从狮子拱门一段加入主线。

zh-CN\u0000瘟疫侵袭凯珊，东悟与明月带领英雄追查白影的阴谋。凯珊新角色.text: 瘟疫侵袭凯珊，东悟与明月带领英雄追查白影的阴谋。凯珊新角色由星岬寺开始；其他篇章角色从北方码头进入凯宁城的剧情。

zh-CN\u0000地震与毁灭者威胁席卷泰瑞亚。英雄经地下通道逃至北方之眼，联.text: 地震与毁灭者威胁席卷泰瑞亚。英雄经地下通道逃至北方之眼，联合阿苏拉、诺恩和黑檀先锋队，对抗大毁灭者。

zh-CN\u0000毁灭前的训练结束后，角色来到两年后的阿斯卡隆。鲁里克王子在.text: 毁灭前的训练结束后，角色来到两年后的阿斯卡隆。鲁里克王子在夏尔入侵中组织抵抗，随后率难民越过席娃山脉；他在霜门的撤离途中牺牲。

zh-CN\u0000抵达科瑞塔后，英雄最初协助白斗篷抵御亡灵。追查获选者的去向.text: 抵达科瑞塔后，英雄最初协助白斗篷抵御亡灵。追查获选者的去向时，他们发现白斗篷献祭无辜者，转而与光刃并肩作战；马基斯的背叛迫使众人撤离。

zh-CN\u0000在图瑞·欧萨的指引下，英雄通过三项试炼与镜像之战，进入巨龙.text: 在图瑞·欧萨的指引下，英雄通过三项试炼与镜像之战，进入巨龙格琳特的巢穴。格琳特揭示白斗篷主人是马赛特，并解释寻火者预言。

zh-CN\u0000英雄营救光刃，与先知接触并获得灌注以抵御马赛特的幽灵痛苦，.text: 英雄营救光刃，与先知接触并获得灌注以抵御马赛特的幽灵痛苦，随后帮助矮人夺回雷云要塞。

zh-CN\u0000基尔布隆引导英雄破坏科马里之门的封印，释放泰坦。他随后暴露.text: 基尔布隆引导英雄破坏科马里之门的封印，释放泰坦。他随后暴露巫妖身份，试图借欧尔权杖控制泰坦。英雄最终击败巫妖，再次封闭大门。

zh-CN\u0000主线结束后，格琳特指引英雄阻止失控泰坦袭击各地，并追击北方.text: 主线结束后，格琳特指引英雄阻止失控泰坦袭击各地，并追击北方的泰坦首领。这是后续任务，不能与最终主线任务混为一项。

zh-CN\u0000东悟与学生在曹大臣庄园发现瘟疫，追查至善台郡后辨认出白影的.text: 东悟与学生在曹大臣庄园发现瘟疫，追查至善台郡后辨认出白影的标记，随后赴凯宁城求援。

zh-CN\u0000英雄分别取得圣维克特骨灰瓮与阿克摩如斯长矛，在孙江行政区关.text: 英雄分别取得圣维克特骨灰瓮与阿克摩如斯长矛，在孙江行政区关闭裂隙，却得知圣物只能暂时阻止白影。

zh-CN\u0000英雄可协助库兹柯守护永恒之林，或协助勒克森保护盖拉孵化所的.text: 英雄可协助库兹柯守护永恒之林，或协助勒克森保护盖拉孵化所的幼龟。面对共同的瘟疫威胁，两方形成合作，故事在沉睡之水重新汇合。

zh-CN\u0000英雄解除白影对盐蛟昆纳维的控制，攻入莱苏皇宫。东悟为救皇帝.text: 英雄解除白影对盐蛟昆纳维的控制，攻入莱苏皇宫。东悟为救皇帝牺牲，白影借皇族之血重返人间；英雄随后在帝国圣所击败他。

zh-CN\u0000日戟新兵抵御海盗，追查古代遗迹中的恶兆，发现科瑞纳将领卡叶.text: 日戟新兵抵御海盗，追查古代遗迹中的恶兆，发现科瑞纳将领卡叶特与海盗合作，并得知瓦蕾丝试图释放阿巴顿。

zh-CN\u0000日戟军在领事馆码头遭重创，转入地下抵抗。英雄救出同伴，穿过.text: 日戟军在领事馆码头遭重创，转入地下抵抗。英雄救出同伴，穿过科瑞纳进入瓦比；一段任务取决于选择玛格丽特或密语大师。

zh-CN\u0000瓦比王侯面临暗影军团侵袭。先前选择的英雄决定达沙前庭或卓坎.text: 瓦比王侯面临暗影军团侵袭。先前选择的英雄决定达沙前庭或卓坎诺要塞路线；之后可选择救援罗鳩村，或夺回瑟伯欣花园。

zh-CN\u0000英雄与帕拉瓦·约克交易，学会搭乘巨奴虫穿越致命的硫磺地带，.text: 英雄与帕拉瓦·约克交易，学会搭乘巨奴虫穿越致命的硫磺地带，并在摩拉废墟击败瓦蕾丝；此时黑暗逆袭已经侵入现实。

zh-CN\u0000英雄在折磨领域重遇寇米尔，解放受困灵魂，并在疯狂之门击败巫.text: 英雄在折磨领域重遇寇米尔，解放受困灵魂，并在疯狂之门击败巫妖与白影。阿巴顿被击败后，逸散的力量威胁整个领域；寇米尔承接这股力量，成为掌管真相、知识与秘密的新神。

zh-CN\u0000角色从各自大陆的地震调查任务进入地下，结识奥格登与维克，并.text: 角色从各自大陆的地震调查任务进入地下，结识奥格登与维克，并抵达北方之眼，与关及黑檀先锋队会合。

zh-CN\u0000英雄召集乌拉、盖德与伦克等阿苏拉学者，保护魔像计划，并利用.text: 英雄召集乌拉、盖德与伦克等阿苏拉学者，保护魔像计划，并利用魔像突袭毁灭者巢穴。

zh-CN\u0000关与英雄寻找失踪的黑檀先锋队，与反抗萨满阶层的夏尔烈焰战士.text: 关与英雄寻找失踪的黑檀先锋队，与反抗萨满阶层的夏尔烈焰战士皮雷合作，最终突袭要塞并解救兰玛队长等人。

zh-CN\u0000英雄协助乔拉终结变为诺恩熊的兄长，夺回家园并保护诺恩的圣地.text: 英雄协助乔拉终结变为诺恩熊的兄长，夺回家园并保护诺恩的圣地，赢得诺恩的支持。

zh-CN\u0000盟友集结后，英雄在席娃之心取得古老神器。贾里斯举行大矮人仪.text: 盟友集结后，英雄在席娃之心取得古老神器。贾里斯举行大矮人仪式，让多数矮人化为石矮人。联军深入中央传送室，击败大毁灭者，瓦解毁灭者的协同行动。

zh-CN\u0000前三项沙漠任务可按任意顺序完成，但飞升流程需要全部完成；这.text: 前三项沙漠任务可按任意顺序完成，但飞升流程需要全部完成；这里并非三条互斥分支。

zh-CN\u0000预言允许跳过部分前段任务；上述内容是剧情脉络，不表示每个任.text: 预言允许跳过部分前段任务；上述内容是剧情脉络，不表示每个任务都是通关必做条件。

zh-CN\u0000永恒之林与盖拉孵化所属于替代路线；继续主线不要求依次完成两.text: 永恒之林与盖拉孵化所属于替代路线；继续主线不要求依次完成两条阵营路线。

zh-CN\u0000第二幕的阿苏拉、先锋队、诺恩三条故事线可以按任意顺序推进，.text: 第二幕的阿苏拉、先锋队、诺恩三条故事线可以按任意顺序推进，最终需要全部完成；诺恩线中的后两条任务也有并列前置关系。

en\u0000Although this is a PBAoE skill w.text: Although this is a PBAoE skill with an effect centered around the caster, it still needs an allied target and you will run towards that target if not in cast range. Similar to Hex Eater Signet, the target won't be affected if it is not in range.

en\u0000Because it is a targeted enchant.text: Because it is a targeted enchantment spell, it will always trigger Shame and Mark of Subversion. If standing in a Well of the Profane, you will be able to cast this enchantment if you pick any ally in cast range that is not inside the well.

en\u0000The concise description omits th.text: The concise description omits the fact that your health gain (and your target's health loss) is capped by your maximum health.

en\u0000Does not properly convert the ph.text: Does not properly convert the physical damage of certain skills (notably: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support and Veil of Thorns). As a result, the skill chain will not trigger the conditional effects of other skills that depend on fire damage (in particular, for Intensity).

en\u0000Contrary to the description, Pea.text: Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all new conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration reduced by 90%.

en\u0000The tiny delay between the targe.text: The tiny delay between the target being teleported to the casters location and being resurrected is long enough for an AI to possibly use "We Shall Return!", which takes place before UA's resurrecting effect.

en\u0000The \"random\" resurrected party.text: The "random" resurrected party member is almost always the one closest to the caster when the skill is cancelled. You can therefor pick which target to rez by moving on top of the corpse before cancelling.

en\u0000If you are moving when it ends,.text: If you are moving when it ends, the resurrected party member will be teleported to where you started running or where you last changed direction, not to your current position.

en\u0000The concise description states t.text: The concise description states that foes attacking target ally will be knocked down and suffer damage; however, this effect only occurs when the target ally is successfully hit.

en\u0000If two foes hexed with Fevered D.text: If two foes hexed with Fevered Dreams are next to each other and one of them starts suffering from a new condition, both will be Dazed.

en\u0000Monsters won't cast Migraine on.text: Monsters won't cast Migraine on you when at least five of your skills are recharging.

en\u0000At ranks 0-1 Fast Casting, all s.text: At ranks 0-1 Fast Casting, all signets activated within the duration will deal damage and interrupt foes.

en\u0000On some very rare occasions, liv.text: On some very rare occasions, living NPCs will spawn rather than corpses when the golem dies.

en\u0000The skill description implies th.text: The skill description implies that Blind covers Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.

en\u0000Changing your maximum energy low.text: Changing your maximum energy lower than what it was when this was cast on you, will lower your health bonus accordingly to your new energy, however swapping back to higher energy will not bring it back up and it will remain at the lower amount, even if recast on you at higher energy before its duration ends.

en\u0000If a foe with a spell targeting.text: If a foe with a spell targeting prevention skill is targeted, Double Dragon will fail, despite the enchantment applying to the ally nearest to the target foe.

en\u0000Whenever a target under the effe.text: Whenever a target under the effects of Double Dragon is interrupted, the animation restarts.

en\u0000Unlike most area damage over tim.text: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Double Dragon does not cause AI to scatter.

en\u0000The -5 damage reduction is activ.text: The -5 damage reduction is active for the expected duration of each enchantment, not its actual duration. Refreshing an Assassin enchantment before it ends reduces the received damage by an additional -5.

en\u0000Contrary to the concise descript.text: Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.

en\u0000Ritual Lord will only increase t.text: Ritual Lord will only increase the skill progression of a skill, and not inherent effects from Spawning Power.

en\u0000With skills that remove \"all en.text: With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), an instance of this skill's damage will trigger for each Dervish enchantment except for Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, or Vow of Revolution. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Aura of Holy Might (plus Aura of Holy Might itself).

en\u0000Contrary to descriptions, this s.text: Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.

en\u0000The skill descriptions omit that.text: The skill descriptions omit that only party members within earshot are affected.

en\u0000Against unenchanted targets this.text: Against unenchanted targets this skill causes block bypassing effects such as Asuran Scan or Warrior's Cunning to be ignored.

en\u0000The full description omits that.text: The full description omits that this skill needs your pet to be alive to activate.

en\u0000Targeting yourself or an ally wi.text: Targeting yourself or an ally will sometimes cause your pet to stop moving. It will unfreeze when an opponent enters your aggro bubble or attacks it. This is exploited to perform the portal jumping technique known as a SaO chain.

en\u0000Strike as One's description omit.text: Strike as One's description omits the fact that it has a limited duration of 30 seconds.

en\u0000The French description of the sk.text: The French description of the skill mention an "enemy target" for the shadow step despite the fact that the skill can target either foe or friend

en\u0000Does not double adrenaline gain.text: Does not double adrenaline gain from all sources as stated, but rather gives one additional strike of adrenaline per attack. Despite this, it still does not stack with other skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain, such as "For Great Justice!" or Weapon of Fury, but stacks additively with Mark of Fury or Dark Fury.

en\u0000Doesn't work against Psychic Ins.text: Doesn't work against Psychic Instability or Tremor.

en\u0000Even though it has no activation.text: Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Dolyak Signet) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.

en\u0000After being resurrected, if the.text: After being resurrected, if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.

en\u0000The descriptions do not mention.text: The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.

en\u0000This skill can not be cast if yo.text: This skill can not be cast if you are targeting someone under Spell Breaker, Vow of Silence etc. and triggers the spell Mistrust, acting like a target foe spell.

en\u0000If an enchantment duration is re.text: If an enchantment duration is reduced below 1 second, it behaves as if it was not applied.

en\u0000Although the description says \".text: Although the description says "150…270…300% faster", the actual behavior is "at 150…270…300% the normal rate", which is only 50…170…200% faster.

en\u0000Items that grant a 20% chance of.text: Items that grant a 20% chance of adding +1 to Illusion Magic do not affect spells cast while this signet is active. For example, you cannot use "Master of My Domain" to obtain rank 21 in the table above. Instead, spells will use the unmodified Illusion rank.

en\u0000Unlike all other Elementalist sk.text: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Sandstorm and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.

en\u0000Invoke Lightning's animation sho.text: Invoke Lightning's animation shows strikes on all possible targets, not just the three that are actually hit.

en\u0000Unlike all other Elementalist sk.text: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.

en\u0000While under the effects of Maste.text: While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.

en\u0000This skill replaces your dagger'.text: This skill replaces your dagger's attack damage with the stated damage, which is non-armor-ignoring damage (unlike other attack skills such as Distracting Shot and Needling Shot). This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.

en\u0000The concise description fails to.text: The concise description fails to mention that only daze will not have effect if not enchanted (the attack will not fail).

en\u0000Crippling modifiers on weapons d.text: Crippling modifiers on weapons do not extend the duration of cripple caused by the end effect.

en\u0000This spell does not have an afte.text: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.

en\u0000When dropped, the chat log notes.text: When dropped, the chat log notes your dropping the ashes as "You drop a Destructive was Glaive." When most ashes from an item spell are dropped, the chat log notes this as "You drop an Ashes of..." followed by the name of the item spell. Example: "You drop an Ashes of Grasping Kuurong."

en\u0000If used when taking damage from.text: If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.

en\u0000The skill states it will end on.text: The skill states it will end on all other allies, however, it will only end on party members of the ally that it triggers on, not all allies.

en\u0000Despite the skill descriptions,.text: Despite the skill descriptions, this skill triggers with health degeneration, health loss, life stealing, and health sacrifice, not just damage.

en\u0000Unlike most skills that increase.text: Unlike most skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier, this increases all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.

en\u0000Similar to Cracked Armor, this s.text: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.

en\u0000If you use a skill or combinatio.text: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Soldier's Fury's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.

en\u0000If a condition is removed, Leade.text: If a condition is removed, Leadership will restore energy as if it affected two targets, requiring minimum 8 Leadership to receive the doubled benefit. This causes it to have a net cost of 1 energy.

en\u0000Re-application does not reset th.text: Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.

en\u0000Although the effect extends beyo.text: Although the effect extends beyond party range, the AI only considers allies within the expected range.

en\u0000This skill currently only grants.text: This skill currently only grants 1 energy per enchantment

en\u0000Despite the full description, a.text: Despite the full description, a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.

en\u0000This is the only skill that has.text: This is the only skill that has health degeneration shown with positive value in the description.

en\u0000This enchantment can be cast whi.text: This enchantment can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.

en\u0000When sorting skills by campaign,.text: When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Nightfall skill.

en\u0000If two people cast this spell on.text: If two people cast this spell on one target, both will take effect; however, only one enchantment will show on the effects monitor.

en\u0000The heal amount is based on your.text: The heal amount is based on your rank of Divine Favor at the time of each hit rather than at the initial casting, i.e. if your attributes are increased/decreased while the enchantment is in effect, the heal amount will change accordingly.

en\u0000This skill actually causes healt.text: This skill actually causes health gain.

en\u0000Contrary to the description, the.text: Contrary to the description, the healing from this skill is gained through life stealing rather than a heal. Therefore, the heal is unaffected by hexes that reduce healing such as Lingering Curse or Defile Flesh, and the spirit will not take damage from healer-punishing hexes such as Scourge Healing or Soul Bind.

en\u0000The distance of healing is much.text: The distance of healing is much greater than spirit range and it seems that healing covers all the current location.

en\u0000The Spirit of Vampirism's attack.text: The Spirit of Vampirism's attack skill is a monster skill independent of the Sunspear rank. Unlike the progression of other Sunspear skills after the May 17, 2012 update, Vampirism's life stealing continues to follow the progression prior to that update (i.e. maximum effectiveness is reached at Sunspear rank 10 instead of 5) even though the descriptions display 20 life stealing from rank 5 to 9.

en\u0000Although it is classified as a F.text: Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.

en\u0000If you obtain a new skill (as a.text: If you obtain a new skill (as a quest reward) you may equip it in any of the free slots and use it. After turning back to human form, you keep the skill but cannot use it until you swap it with another skill.

en\u0000Unlike other skills without an a.text: Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard aftercast delay of 0.75 second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.

en\u0000Foes affected by this skill cann.text: Foes affected by this skill cannot miss.

en\u0000If recast before the duration en.text: If recast before the duration ends, Dwarven Stability will end before being reapplied, triggering Meditation and other relevant skills.

en\u0000This attack is not affected by F.text: This attack is not affected by Favourable Winds extra damage even when used wielding a bow, unlike similar flat armor ignoring damage attack skills like Needling Shot or Power Shot.

en\u0000Attack skills that deal entirely.text: Attack skills that deal entirely armor-ignoring damage, such as Banishing Strike, are still increased.

en\u0000Winds does not appear on the eff.text: Winds does not appear on the effects monitor.

en\u0000The armor bonus while fighting C.text: The armor bonus while fighting Charr is calculated as two sources, the initial +24 armor and then the +24 armor against Charr. The armor bonus is therefore capped at +25 armor due to effect stacking (giving a 35.2% damage reduction bonus).

en\u0000The Assassin doesn't shadow step.text: The Assassin doesn't shadow step; it is spawned directly next to the target.

en\u0000The Assassin is counted as a cre.text: The Assassin is counted as a created creature for Spirit's Gift, Explosive Growth, and Boon of Creation. However, it does not count as a summoned creature and is not affected by Spawning Power. Despite this classification, it is not affected by sulfur.

en\u0000Though the Assassin does not cou.text: Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.

en\u0000The Assassin does not always tar.text: The Assassin does not always target the foe targeted by the caster, but instead targets the foe closest to its creation point.

en\u0000Very rarely, the assassin may su.text: Very rarely, the assassin may survive indefinitely. This can occur if resurrected by an enemy-created Restoration spirit, as by Reborn Irukandji.

en\u0000When sorting skills by type in t.text: When sorting skills by type in the Skills and Attributes Panel, this skill is under its own "Melee Attack" category, while all the other melee attacks are in a separate "Melee Attack" category.

en\u0000This skill ignores the effects o.text: This skill ignores the effects of skills that provide health bonuses, such as Endure Pain, when calculating 50% of the health; the target's health needs to be 50% of what it would be without the bonus.

en\u0000Unlike most shouts, \"I Am the S.text: Unlike most shouts, "I Am the Strongest!" ends if it's reapplied before it expires, triggering the effects of echoes.

en\u0000Similarly to Illusionary Weaponr.text: Similarly to Illusionary Weaponry and Mantra of Signets, the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.

en\u0000*Unlike other scarabs, she is a.text:
*Unlike other scarabs, she is a ranged attacker.
*Sometimes she is hidden at first and won't pop up until a party member approaches her spawn point. 
*She is surrounded by several Scarab Nest Builders who use lots of traps. Melee characters should be especially careful.
*The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range.
*Kepkhet can be pulled and won't return to the nest if at least one of the Scarab Nest Builders has been killed.
*If she casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity which will remove Mark of Protection.
*Aurek the Scarab Hunter in Augury Rock (outpost) tells you of her existence and that he has been hunting her.

en\u0000* Strategy: After killing the tw.text:
* Strategy: After killing the two Chaos Wurms, head to the left side and kill the popups (there is no need to go to the right side (unless farming for ecto)). From the left side stairway, target the nearest Terrorweb Dryder and pull with a bow. That will pull the Darknesses as well, but if you back up enough the Darknesses will return, and the Dryders will still follow you. Do not retreat too far or the Dryders will break aggro and return.
** This pull usually only works once, once the Dryders return they cannot be pulled away again. Kill the Dryders and then the Darknesses will be alone. This is a good strategy for players that solo farm the Tomb of the Primeval Kings.

en\u0000* The Drought is a non-demonic s.text:
* The Drought is a non-demonic servant of Abaddon; Lightbringer's Gaze is useless against it.
* The following tactics are effective in dealing with the Drought:
** Winter will negate the bonuses from earth damage.
** The Drought can be shutdown by daze, Power Block or knock downs. 
** Pain Inverter is even more effective using a minion master to exploit Sandstorm's area of effect damage — the more minions that get hit, the more damage there is to invert.
** Protective Spirit is effective, since the Drought almost always hits for over 200 damage.
** Shelter provides enough party-wide protection to kill the Drought using the Pain Inverter strategy (it generally will not survive more than one Sandstorm).

There are small mobs along the way, but this should be remedied with a decent party. This is a longer, but safer way to approach the boss without having to suffer any sort of death penalty.

en\u0000* It does huge amounts of AoE da.text:
* It does huge amounts of AoE damage and often causes knockdown.
* Replaced by Edielh Shockhunter after completion of Prenuptial Disagreement.
* Pain Inverter will be useful, as it will trigger more often due to the AoE, and additionally up to three times per ally because of Shockwave.
* This boss, like most Wurm bosses, does not need to be killed when vanquishing as long as it is not above ground.
* If this boss dies while underground, you will not be able to capture skills from it.

en\u0000* Whiteout resides at the top of.text:
* Whiteout resides at the top of a steep rise, on a narrow path. 
** Beware of tumbling boulders that can instantly kill anyone in their path. 
** If you are using heroes and/or henchmen, flag them at the bottom of the rise, the walk up the path to trigger the boulders so that you can more easily dodge them.
* Whiteout is accompanied by an Avalanche and two Ice Elementals, but is very vulnerable to fire damage.
** Focus everyone's attack on Whiteout and he will go down quickly. After killing him your party will be able to take out the rest of the enemies.
** To farm this boss, rezone at the nearby Frostmaw's Burrows dungeon portal.

en\u0000*Try to take out the patrols nea.text: *Try to take out the patrols nearby before you attempt to kill him or you might find yourself overwhelmed.

en\u0000* When close to the edge of the.text:
* When close to the edge of the player's compass, Molotov Rocktail will begin a patrol to the north east and continue a short way into the forest.
* His Devourer Siege can easily wipe out a party that is not spread out; flag heroes and henchmen around or underneath him and either interrupt or blind him, preventing both his Devourer Siege and Power Attack.
* You can tank Rocktail using the nearby Siege Devourer: since it rarely uses Devourer Siege once in melee, you can use the durability of the Siege Devourer to approach it alone and lock it in melee safely, even in hard mode.
* Molotov Rocktail has an extended aggro range, much like Kournan Spotters.
* Due to Devourer Siege, Pain Inverter is very effective, since it reflects damage from your minions, spirits, summons, and animal companions.

en\u0000* Care must be taken with this g.text:
* Care must be taken with this group (and the other groups of Burning Spirits), as they have a wide patrol range and can quickly ambush and wipe your group while fighting other enemies. They are also highly resistant to fire damage and immune to burning, so other categories of elemental spells should be used against them. 
* Consider bringing AoE interrupts such as Cry of Frustration, Tease, or a ranger with Choking Gas. 
:* The interrupt Complicate, when used on Searing Flames, is particularly effective as it will shut down the entire mob's main source of damage.
* Hex Eater Vortex and Shatter Hex can also be useful in removing Mark of Rodgort from melee characters and dealing large armor-ignoring damage to nearby foes. 
* Pre-interrupts such as Guilt and Mistrust can help in interrupting the multiple copies of Searing Flames.
* Winter will prevent Mark of Rodgort and the spike damage from Searing Flames from triggering and significantly boost damage from your elemental sources.
* Elementalists should consider bringing Frigid Armor to effectively prevent any damage from Searing Flames.

en\u0000*You need to have done the Assau.text:

*He will not spawn if you have the quest Forbidden Fruit active.

en\u0000* As a hammer warrior, he can be.text:
* As a hammer warrior, he can be handled with any anti-melee build.
* As with Borrguus Blisterbark, it is a good idea to kill the roving patrols of Burning Spirits before you take him and his group on, otherwise it is very likely that you will get ambushed and likely wiped out.
* Ignus is the only Titan boss who does not follow the typical naming convention of Titan bosses of two pseudo-Latin words.

en\u0000* The fight is made difficult by.text:
* The fight is made difficult by the large number of both Grawl Champions and Grawl Dark Priests which surround him. Approaching him from the south, four of the closest Grawl Champions can be pulled away from the group, but all the others attack cohesively along with the boss.
* Area-of-effect anti-melee hexes such as Meekness and Enfeebling Blood are very useful, along with wards such as Ward Against Melee and Ebon Battle Standard of Courage. As always, a minion master can greatly help redirect damage from the team.

en\u0000* A Charr Effigy will spawn once.text: * A Charr Effigy will spawn once he is aggroed.

en\u0000* As with various quest-related.text: * As with various quest-related foes, once it spawns, it might cause an additional Locked Chest to spawn.

en\u0000* His route is approximately 5 m.text:
* His route is approximately 5 minutes in length, varying in direction and path per spawn. It patrols around the edge of the northeastern lagoon more often than the south route.
* Flannuss usually becomes stuck on a cliff almost directly south of Vlox's Falls, at the northernmost tip of the land jutting into the river delta - marked with the monk icon on the wiki map. The quickest way to locate the boss should be to travel clockwise on the red path. Alternatively, wait in the spot where it may get stuck - both patrol routes overlap here.
* An easy (but repetitive) method for killing Flannuss is to zone into Arbor Bay from Vlox's Falls head forward, killing the first two groups of Krait and heading left along the cliff tops. If he is not there, he will likely be there in two minutes - otherwise he is on the other route, so rezone and try again.

en\u0000* He can hit hard, so it is advi.text:
* He can hit hard, so it is advised to take some interrupt skills.
* Spoil Victor and Pain Inverter are very effective against Joffs. Enchantment removal will also help by removing his protective spells.
* Due to the nature of the damage from Shockwave, it is advisable to space out your party as best as you possibly can to avoid a devastating spike which could very well kill your entire party.
* After killing the surrounding enemies, it is possible to lure Joffs to the southeast past a large rock/hill, where he will become stuck as he tries to get back to his spawn. It is then possible to defeat him with minimal casualties as he will simply walk back and forth as you attack him.

en\u0000* The Broodmother's cave is just.text:
* The Broodmother's cave is just south of the northern exit in Rata Sum. Not far from her spawn point, you can find a Jar of Invigoration; when dropped, it provides 30 energy to all nearby creatures.
* The cave is filled with three large groups of level 15 Raptor Nestlings. Although they deal relatively little damage, they spam Disrupting Stab, preventing your team from using skills effectively. Rekoff herself deals large amounts of damage. Bring a team that can deal effectively with significant amounts of melee and bring interruption counter-tactics.
* Since the cave is so close to Rata Sum, her group is used to farm Asura reputation points and festival trophy drops. The popularity of the farm also means that Claws of the Broodmother are very common and do not trade at a premium.

en\u0000* You can counter Mobrin's heavy.text:
* You can counter Mobrin's heavy damage with skills that cause weakness or blindness.
* Compared to a regular Tyrannus, Mobrin trades out the anti-block knockdown of Leviathan's Sweep for the cleaving potential of Sweeping Strikes.

en\u0000* A Siege Devourer can be used t.text:
* A Siege Devourer can be used to easily take down the large mob that accompanies Fureyst Sharpsight, making the battle considerably easier. 
** It is possible to acquire one early directly to the south of Doomlore Shrine in Dalada Uplands. Take then the portal to Grothmar Wardowns then go south to Sacnoth Valley for a slightly faster route.
** In Hard Mode, a Siege Devourer will spawn near Fureyst Sharpsight. With a runner it is possible to quickly reach Rragar's Menagerie, zone there, then reenter Sacnoth Valley, take the devourer and proceed from there. The runner can still be useful in combat by mounting the devourer themselves.

en\u0000Ranger Tamer Mask is a mask art.text:

** Piles of Glittering Dust.

=== Coloring notes ===
* When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters.
* Part of the glow is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being drunk).
* Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change).
When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.
If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.

en\u0000*Nicholas sometimes fails to app.text:
*Nicholas sometimes fails to appear in his expected location:
**Active quests can alter spawns in the area. To fix this, complete or abandon the local quests before returning. Alternatively, visit the area with a different character without the relevant quests.
**Some areas have variable spawns (e.g. Pockmark Flats); rezoning a few times will address this.
**He has sometimes failed to spawn due to the War in Kryta (e.g. in Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)); if not previously fixed by ArenaNet, you can work around this by using a character who has not started WiK or dropping any relevant bounties for characters that have finished WiK.
**Winds of Change might have a similar effect. For example, for the week of Putrid Cysts, you must not have Winds of Change active. To temporarily undo Winds of Change, take Memories of Purity from the Herald of Purity in Kaineng Center (requires completion of Cleansing Morostav Trail).
*Nicholas does not exchange items for gifts in two situations:
**If you enter an area before Nick's scheduled move time, but do not reach him until afterward, Nick will not speak to you at all.
**He attends The Wedding as a guest of Gwen, but not as a collector.
*Nicholas has occasionally been found facing a random object, obstructive landscape, or a wall.
*Nicksets are commonly traded in Kamadan or near the outpost where Nicholas is currently located. A nickset represents the exact quantity of an item required to obtain all 5 weekly Gifts of the Traveler. For example, if Nicholas requires 3 of an item per gift, a nickset consists of 15 of that item (3 × 5).
**Trading nicksets is generally beneficial for the buyer, as 5 Gifts of the Traveler are typically worth more than the nickset itself. The seller benefits from the convenience of not having to locate Nicholas in an explorable area. Note that prices are subject to fluctuation and may reach a point where Gifts of the Traveler are worth less than a nickset, making the trade unfavorable for the buyer.
Sometimes his greeting and/or reward text is not translated into one or more non-English languages. Please report any issues at the localization bug feedback pages so that they can be quickly resolved.

zh-CN\u0000Elite Shout. For 4…9…10 secon.text: 精英呐喊。在 4…9…10 秒内，听力范围内的所有盟友移动速度加快 33%，并在移动时获得 5…13…15 体力。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Shout. Target other all.text: 精英呐喊。目标其他盟友失去所有条件。如果以这种方式删除某个条件，该盟友的移动速度将加快 25%，持续 1…8…10 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Shout. For 2…4…4 second.text: 精英呐喊。在 2…4…4 秒内，听力范围内的所有盟友获得 1…2…2 能量再生。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Chant. For 20 seconds,.text: 精英圣歌。在 20 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一个 1…5…6 技能会消除该盟友的 1 状态。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Chant. For 10 seconds,.text: 精英圣歌。在 10 秒内，下次每个在听力范围内的队员使用技能时，该队员将获得 45…97…110 体力。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Spear Attack. If this a.text: 精英长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成+10…42…50 伤害。如果它击中不移动的目标，则会造成 重伤 持续 5…17…20 秒。
精英长矛攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会造成+10…42…50 伤害。如果它击中患有某种病症的敌人，则该敌人也是 晕眩，持续 4…9…10 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Chant. For 10 seconds,.text: 精英圣歌。 10秒内，听力范围内的每个队员使用的下一个攻击技能都无法被阻挡。
精英圣歌。在 10 秒内，听力范围内的每个盟友使用的下一个攻击技能会造成 5…13…15 秒的瘫痪。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Skill. For 10 seconds,.text: 精英技能。在 10 秒内，下一次听力范围内的盟友受到致命伤害时，该伤害将被抵消，并且该盟友会在 20…164…200 体力 时间内得到治疗。 天使连结 在所有其他盟友上结束。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Chant. For 10 seconds,.text: 精英圣歌。在 10 秒内，听力范围内的所有队员在下次使用攻击技能时获得 2…4…5 怒气 的打击。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Chant. For 4…9…10 secon.text: 精英圣歌。在 4…9…10 秒内，听力范围内的每个队员都有 50% 的几率阻止传入的攻击。如果该队员使用攻击技能命中，则此吟唱结束。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Skill. For 45 seconds,.text: 精英技能。在 45 秒内，您将获得 0…120…150% 的 怒气。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Echo. For 10…30…35 seco.text: 精英回音。在 10…30…35 秒内，如果你处于圣歌或喊叫的效果下，你的攻击速度会加快 33%，并获得更多 33% 怒气，但你有 -20 护甲。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Signet. All party membe.text: 精英图章。所有党员失去一切条件。你着火了 “Fire”是大写的，与其他描述不同的是，对于以这种方式删除的每个条件，“着火”为 1 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Flash Enchantment Spell.text: 精英闪光加持咒文。当你施放此结界时，附近的所有敌人都会被致盲 1…6…7 秒。在 30 秒内，如果你使用土系武器，你的近战攻击会造成 +3…25…30 土系伤害。当这个结界结束时，你的 失明 就被治愈了。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Enchantment Spell. For.text: 精英加持咒文。在 15 秒内，每当你用镰刀攻击敌人时，你都会对所有相邻敌人造成 10…22…25 削减伤害。
精英加持咒文。在 10 秒内，每当你施展法术时，你身上的每个结界都会获得 2 能量（最多 2…6…7 能量）。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seco.text: 精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你获得 +20 防御物理伤害的护甲值，你获得 怒气 25% 的速度更快，你的攻击造成神圣伤害，每当你失去 神唤 结界时，附近的敌人就会着火，持续 1…3…3 秒。该技能禁用 45 秒。
精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你的攻击造成神圣伤害。每当你使用 神唤 攻击技能时，你就会失去 1 十六进制。每当你失去 神唤 结界时，听力范围内的所有盟友都会获得 5…41…50 体力 的治疗。该技能禁用 45 秒。
精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你的镰刀攻击造成黑暗伤害，并窃取 0…10…12 体力。你对 疾病 免疫，并且每当你失去 神唤 结界时，就会对所有相邻敌人造成 疾病 持续 3 秒。该技能禁用 45 秒。
精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你的 神唤 结界充能速度加快 50%，并且你的攻击会造成混乱伤害。每当你失去 神唤 结界时，从附近所有敌人那里窃取 1 能量。该技能禁用 45 秒。
精英形态。在 10…74…90 秒内，你拥有 +150 体力、+30 元素护甲，并且你的攻击会造成土属性伤害。每当你失去 神唤 结界时，听力范围内的所有党员都会失去 1 状态。该技能禁用 45 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Flash Enchantment Spell.text: 精英闪光加持咒文。在 8 秒内，没有任何反应。当此结界结束时，神性修补 会重新充能，并且你获得 0…4…5 能量 和 0…24…30 体力。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Enchantment Spell. For.text: 精英加持咒文。在 5…9…10 秒内，你不能成为法术的目标，也不能施展法术。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Scythe Attack. If this.text: 精英镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击命中，你会使目标瘫痪 3…13…15 秒。你失去了 1 神唤 结界。如果结界被移除，则该攻击会击倒 2…3…3 秒。
精英镰刀攻击。如果这次攻击击中，你造成+5…17…20伤害，目标敌人遭受流血持续5…17…20秒，并且你失去1 神唤结界。如果结界被移除，目标敌人也会受到 重伤 的影响，持续 5…17…20 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Flash Enchantment Spell.text: 精英闪光加持咒文。在 20 秒内，你的攻击技能还会使该敌人瘫痪 1…9…11 秒，并且你将 1…3…3 状况从自己转移到该敌人身上。
精英闪光加持咒文。在 3…13…15 秒内，您的攻击、移动和获得 怒气 25% 的速度更快。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Enchantment Spell. For.text: 精英加持咒文。在20秒内，你有-2 能量再生，并且每次你攻击时你都会获得1…5…6 能量。

zh-CN\u0000Signet. If you are within the.text: 印章。如果你在阿巴顿恶魔仆从的区域内，你将获得 4…5 怒气 和 22…24 能量 的攻击。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Skill. Spit a projectil.text: 精英技能。向目标敌人吐出射弹。它会造成 400 土属性伤害，并击倒目标敌人。该技能不能对附近的敌人使用。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Echo. For 3…13…15 secon.text: 精英回音。在 3…13…15 秒内，目标非精神盟友的所有属性获得 +1…3…3。每当该盟友的吟唱或喊叫结束时，都会重新应用此回声。 PvE技能

zh-CN\u0000Elite Melee Attack. Attack ta.text: 精英近战攻击。攻击目标和邻近的敌人。大多数技能的每次攻击都会造成+13…27…30 神圣伤害，神圣的“h”是小写的，会击倒攻击的敌人。 PvE技能

zh-CN\u0000Elite Enchantment Spell. For.text: 精英加持咒文。对于 3…9…10 秒，您有 +1…5…6 能量再生。每次您使用非 神唤 技能时，该技能都会重新应用。 PvE技能

zh-CN\u0000Enchantment Spell. For 4 seco.text: 加持咒文。对于 致命攻击 的每个等级，对于 4 秒和 1 秒，你攻击 33% 的速度更快，并获得 +15…25 护甲。每次你受到重击时，该技能都会重新应用。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Interrupt target foe's.text: 拼写。打断目标敌人的技能。如果该敌人受到 幻术 六角形的影响，则该敌人和该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 25…50 伤害，并受到 3…5 体力 退化，持续 10 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Shout. For 4 seconds and 1 se.text: 喊。对于 领导 中的每个 2 等级，对于 4 秒和 1 秒，听力范围内的所有党员都会受到 20…35% 的伤害。当喊声结束时，受影响的队员会获得 35…60 体力 的治疗。

zh-CN\u0000Elite Form. You lose all effe.text: 精英形态。你失去了所有效果并呈现出乌鸦的样子。在 60 秒内，你有 80 盔甲、660…700 体力 和 20…30% 的格挡几率，你的所有属性都设置为 0，乌鸦攻击取代你的技能。
精英形态。你失去所有效果并呈现出熊的样子。在 60 秒内，你拥有 100 装甲和 750…790…800 体力。你的所有属性都设置为0，熊攻击取代了你的技能。
精英形态。你失去所有效果并呈现出狼的样子。在 60 秒内，你拥有 80 盔甲、660…700 体力 和 2…4 体力再生。你的所有属性都设置为0，狼攻击取代了你的技能。

zh-CN\u0000Skill. For 20…30 seconds you.text: 技能。在 20…30 秒内，每次你通过杀死敌人获得经验时，你都会获得随机的阿修罗好处。

zh-CN\u0000Enchantment Spell. You have +.text: 加持咒文。你有 +100 最大 体力。当此结界结束时，该区域内的所有队员都会以 40…50% 体力 和 20…30% 能量 复活。

zh-CN\u0000Skill. For 10 seconds, the ne.text: 技能。在 10 秒内，下次你用法术对目标造成元素伤害时，你会对区域内的所有其他敌人造成 60…70% 的伤害。

zh-CN\u0000Skill. If target foe is suffe.text: 技能。如果目标敌人患有某种状况或妖术，则该敌人会受到 60…90 伤害。

zh-CN\u0000Skill. For 18…25 seconds, you.text: 技能。在 18…25 秒内，你和你的宠物攻击速度 25%，并且拥有 +1…3 体力再生。

zh-CN\u0000Enchantment Spell. For 2…5 se.text: 加持咒文。在 2…5 秒内，每当目标其他盟友受到伤害时，所有队伍成员都会受到 神恩 中每个等级的 2 体力 治疗。

zh-CN\u0000Binding Ritual. Create a leve.text: 绑定仪式。创建一个等级 4…14 的精魂，在 75…150 秒后死亡。该战魂的攻击偷取10…20 体力，并治愈10…20 体力。

zh-CN\u0000Melee Attack. Attack target a.text: 近战攻击。攻击目标和邻近的敌人。每次攻击都会造成 +13…20 伤害。

zh-CN\u0000Hex Spell. For 9…12 seconds y.text: 诅咒咒文。在 9…12 秒内，你的攻击不会错过目标敌人。杀死被 阿苏拉之掠(阿苏拉) 诅咒的敌人会消除 5% 的死刑。

zh-CN\u0000Enchantment Spell. For 5…11 s.text: 加持咒文。在 5…11 秒内，你有 50% 的几率阻止攻击。每当敌人攻击你时，这个结界就会重新施加。

zh-CN\u0000Enchantment Spell. For 10…16.text: 加持咒文。在 10…16 秒内，你的移动速度会加快 20…33%，而你的法术施放时间会减少 20%。

zh-CN\u0000Hex Spell. For 6…10 seconds,.text: 诅咒咒文。在 6…10 秒内，每次目标敌人造成伤害时，敌人都会承受其造成伤害的 100…140%（最大 80 伤害）。

zh-CN\u0000Ward Spell. For 5 seconds, fo.text: 守卫咒语。在 5 秒内，该区域的敌人有 -4…6 体力 退化。当传送门结束时，该区域的敌人会患病 12…20 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. For 10…20 seconds, one.text: 拼写。在 10…20 秒内，目标敌人会禁用一个随机法术，并且 圆滑罪犯(阿苏拉) 会被该法术取代。您获得 5…10 能量。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Summon a level 14…20 I.text: 拼写。召唤一个等级为 14…20 的冰小鬼，其生命时间为 40…60 秒并拥有冰刺。仅1阿修罗召唤可以激活一次。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Summon a level 14…20 M.text: 拼写。召唤 14…20 等级的穆萨特，其生命时间为 40…60 秒，并具有精力充沛。一次只能激活1阿修罗召唤。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Summon a level 14…20 N.text: 拼写。召唤一个等级为 14…20 的纳迦萨满，其生命时间为 40…60 秒并具有石击能力。仅1阿修罗召唤可以激活一次。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Summon a level 14…20 R.text: 拼写。召唤一个等级为 14…20 红宝石 的神灵，其生命时间为 40…60 秒并具有献祭能力。一次只能激活1阿修罗召唤。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Target foe and all adj.text: 拼写。目标敌人和所有相邻敌人都会受到 30…40 伤害。如果目标敌人不是 Boss，则该敌人和所有相邻敌人都是 晕眩，持续 3…5 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Throw Alkar's Alchemic.text: 拼写。将 阿尔卡的炼金药剂(矮人) 扔向目标敌人。目标和邻近敌人受到 40…50 伤害。驱逐舰会受到额外的 45…70 伤害，并且它们的装甲破裂持续 14…20 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Trap. When Black Powder Mine.text: 陷阱。当 黑火药地雷(矮人) 被触发时，所有附近的敌人都会受到 20…30 伤害，变得失明，并开始 流血，持续 7…10 秒。 黑火药地雷(矮人) 在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

zh-CN\u0000Skill. You headbutt target to.text: 技能。你用头撞目标触及的敌人，造成 45…70 伤害，并击倒该敌人（如果击中）。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. All party members are.text: 拼写。所有党员都解除了 燃烧 的伤害，并治愈了 50…60 体力 的伤害。

zh-CN\u0000Stance. For 72…90 seconds, yo.text: 姿态。在 72…90 秒内，你的移动和攻击速度增加 10…15%。如果你在激活此技能时喝醉了，你的移动和攻击速度会增加25…33%。

zh-CN\u0000Enchantment Spell. For 24…30.text: 加持咒文。对于 24…30 秒，你的姿势持续时间延长 55…100%。如果你在醉酒状态下发动这个技能，你就不会被击倒。

zh-CN\u0000Skill. Target touched foe tak.text: 技能。目标接触的敌人受到 50…70 穿刺伤害，并开始 流血，持续 15…25 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds,.text: 武器咒语。在 20 秒内，对其他盟友的武器攻击造成 +15…20 伤害，并有 28…40% 的几率造成击倒。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Target foe is struck f.text: 拼写。目标敌人受到 54…90 穿刺伤害，并开始 流血，持续 5…25 秒。此攻击有 10% 的几率造成额外 +540…900 穿刺伤害。如果此攻击击中夏尔，它有 25% 的几率造成额外的 +540…900 穿刺伤害。

zh-CN\u0000Signet. For 14…20 seconds, ta.text: 印章。在 14…20 秒内，目标敌人和所有相邻敌人的移动和攻击速度减慢 23…40%。

zh-CN\u0000Trap. When Weakness Trap is t.text: 陷阱。当 虚弱困境(黑檀) 被触发时，附近所有敌人都会被削弱 10…20 秒，并受到 24…50 闪电伤害。所有夏尔都被击倒了。 虚弱困境(黑檀) 在 90 秒后结束。激活该技能时，你很容易被打断。

zh-CN\u0000Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Create.text: 黑檀先锋仪式。创建一个关卡 4…10 精神。其范围内的所有敌人都有 15% 的几率进行远程攻击。该精魂会在 54…90 秒后死亡。

zh-CN\u0000Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon.text: 守卫咒语。您在当前位置种植了 黑檀勇气规范(黑檀)。在 14…20 秒内，该区域的非灵体盟友获得 +24 护甲值以及针对夏尔的额外 +24 护甲值。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. All foes in the area a.text: 拼写。该区域内的所有敌人都会受到 55…80 神圣伤害。指南针上会简要指示隐藏物体的位置。该区域中的任何隐藏物体都会被揭示。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Create a Snow Storm at.text: 拼写。在目标敌人的位置创建一个 雪风暴(矮人)。在 5 秒内，邻近该位置的敌人每秒都会受到 30…40 寒冷伤害。

zh-CN\u0000Ranged Attack. If this attack.text: 远程攻击。如果此攻击命中，目标敌人将受到 18…30 伤害。如果该敌人有裂纹护甲，则开始时间为 流血，持续 18…30 秒。

zh-CN\u0000Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon.text: 守卫咒语。您在当前位置种植了 黑檀战斗荣誉规范(黑檀)。在 14…20 秒内，该区域的非灵体盟友对夏尔造成 +8…15 伤害，并获得额外 +7…10 伤害。

zh-CN\u0000Spell. Shadow Step to target.text: 拼写。暗影步瞄准其他盟友。你和其他盟友的生命值已治愈 70…110。

zh-CN\u0000Melee Attack. If this attack.text: 近战攻击。如果此攻击命中，则会对每个相邻敌人造成 +6…9 伤害（最大 60 伤害）。如果目标敌人是非人类，它就会被击倒。

en\u0000精英斧术攻击。命中时造成额外 10…34…40 点伤害，并对另外.text: Elite Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +10…34…40 damage and hit 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.

en\u0000精英鎚术攻击。命中时击倒目标，并使其虚弱 5…17…20 秒。.text: Elite Hammer Attack. If Devastating Hammer hits, your target is knocked down and suffers from Weakness for 5…17…20 seconds.

en\u0000精英态势。持续 5…17…20 秒，移动速度提高 33%，攻击获.text: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, you move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from attacks. Battle Rage ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.

en\u0000精英技能。持续 15 秒，每当你用剑攻击时，所有邻近敌人受到 1.text: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10…30…35 slashing damage.

en\u0000精英战嚎。音量所及范围内的盟友移除残废病症，并在 5…11…13.text: Elite Shout. Allies in earshot lose the Crippled condition. For 5…11…13 seconds, these allies move 33% faster.

en\u0000精英宠物攻击。宠物尝试发动凶猛冲击，造成额外 13…25…28.text: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts a Ferocious Strike that deals +13…25…28 damage. If that attack hits, you gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 Energy.

en\u0000精英态势。持续 1…7…8 秒，移动速度提高 33%，并有 75.text: Elite Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks.

en\u0000精英弓术攻击。移除你的所有准备技能。向目标及其最多 5 名邻近敌.text: Elite Bow Attack. All your preparations are removed. Shoot arrows at target foe and up to 5 foes adjacent to your target. These arrows strike for +5…17…20 damage if they hit.

en\u0000精英陷阱。触发后持续 2 秒，每秒对附近所有敌人造成 10…34.text: Elite Trap. When Spike Trap is triggered, every second (for 2 seconds), all nearby foes are struck for 10…34…40 piercing damage, become Crippled for 3…21…25 seconds, and are knocked down. Spike Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

en\u0000精英弓术攻击。射出一支飞行速度为普通箭矢两倍的箭。.text: Elite Bow Attack. Shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.

en\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 5…15…17 秒，目标盟友无法成为敌方法术.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…15…17 seconds, target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.

en\u0000精英咒文。治疗目标盟友 5…81…100 点体力；若该盟友体力低.text: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5…81…100 Health. Heal for an additional 30…98…115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.

en\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 5…11…13 秒，目标盟友获得 +3…9….text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…11…13 seconds, target ally gains +3…9…10 Health regeneration and 20…40…45 armor.

en\u0000精英纹章。击倒目标敌人，并对该目标及其所有邻近敌人造成 15…6.text: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 15…63…75 holy damage.

en\u0000精英咒文。将盟友的所有病症及其剩余持续时间转移到你身上。.text: Elite Spell. Transfer all conditions and their remaining durations from your allies to you.

en\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 10 秒，目标其他盟友获得 +3…5…6 能.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, target other ally gains +3…5…6 Energy regeneration.

en\u0000精英降咒。持续 6…25…30 秒，目标及附近所有敌人受到 −1.text: Elite Hex Spell. For 6…25…30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer -1…3…4 Health degeneration, and gain 25% less benefit from healing.

en\u0000精英纹章。将自身所有负面病症转移给目标敌人，持续时间为各病症剩余.text: Elite Signet. Transfer all negative conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. (50% failure chance with Curses 4 or less.)

en\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 20…39…44 秒，区域内盟友免疫疾病；以.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20…39…44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3…13…15 seconds.

en\u0000精英咒文。若目标敌人体力高于你，你获得双方体力差的一半（不超过你.text: Elite Spell. If target foe has more Health than you, you gain half the difference (up to your maximum Health), and that foe loses an equal amount. If this foe has less Health than you, you lose half the difference, and that foe gains an equal amount.

en\u0000精英咒文。目标敌人失去 1…8…10 点能量，每失去 1 点能量.text: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 1…8…10 Energy. For each point of Energy lost, that foe takes 7 damage and all nearby foes take 75% of that damage.

en\u0000精英态势。持续 5…17…20 秒，你施放的法术回复速度提高 3.text: Elite Stance. For 5…17…20 seconds, spells you cast recharge 33% faster.

en\u0000精英降咒。持续 5…17…20 秒，目标移动和攻击速度降低 50.text: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target moves and attacks 50% slower and suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration.

en\u0000精英咒文。目标敌人失去 2…8…9 点能量，每失去 1 点能量，.text: Elite Spell. Target foe loses 2…8…9 Energy. You gain 3 Energy for each point of Energy lost.

en\u0000精英加持魔法。在 30 秒内使用的下一个技能会替换回音，替换后的.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, Echo is replaced with the next skill you use. Echo acts as this skill for 30 seconds.

en\u0000精英降咒。3 秒后，击倒目标敌人，造成 14…83…100 点闪.text: Elite Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe is knocked down and struck for 14…83…100 lightning damage, and has Cracked Armor for 5…17…20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

en\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 8…18…20 秒，获得 +20 护甲，无法.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 8…18…20 seconds, you gain +20 armor and cannot be the target of enemy spells, but cannot attack and have -2 energy degeneration.

en\u0000精英加持魔法。持续 25…53…60 秒，与风、火、水、土四系元.text: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 25…53…60 seconds, you are attuned to Air, Fire, Water, and Earth and gain +1…2…2 to these attributes. You gain 1 Energy plus 50% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use magic associated with any of these elements.

en\u0000精英咒文。目标及其所有邻近敌人受到 15…51…60 点火焰伤害.text: Elite Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes take 15…51…60 fire damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe and all adjacent foes take an additional 15…51…60 fire damage and are set on fire for 1…8…10 seconds.

en\u0000精英降咒。目标受到 10…50…60 点冰冻伤害。若你的能量高于.text: Elite Hex Spell. Target foe takes 10…50…60 cold damage. If you have more Energy than target foe, that foe suffers an additional 10…50…60 cold damage and moves 90% slower for 1…4…5 seconds.

en\u0000物品说明（英文）：A Charr Bag is an equip.text:
Items description (English):A Charr Bag is an equippable item that provides 10 additional inventory spaces. Because they already hold 10 items, they cannot be upgraded by using a Rune of Holding. A Superior Rune of Holding can be applied to it after leaving Pre-Searing and make it hold 15 items. A character may wear up to 2 bags at one time. Bags are not visible to other players.

Charr Bags are most commonly used by players in Pre-Searing who, without access to storage, have little inventory space.

en\u0000物品说明（英文）：A Charr Salvage Kit is.text: Items description (English):A Charr Salvage Kit is a type of kit that provides the only method for pre-Searing characters to obtain upgrade components. They look and work the same as Expert Salvage Kits; however, they have only five uses and they can only be obtained as drops from one of the Charr bosses or Maz's Chest.

en\u0000Wiki 备注（英文）：* This kit used to b.text:
Wiki Remarks (English):* This kit used to be the only means of salvaging equipment modifiers while in pre-Searing Ascalon, including weapon upgrades, Runes, or Insignias. With the introduction of The Purveyor players are able to obtain the Infinite Superior Salvage Kit in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* As with any kit, its value will decrease proportionally as it is used.
* Although it is gold, identifying it will not contribute to the Wisdom title track (however it will increase the value of the kit if sold to a merchant).
* These kits can be used to salvage rare crafting materials, but there is no point in doing so: rare materials cannot be used in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* The base chance, before the Wisdom and Treasure Hunter bonuses, of breaking an item upon salvaging an upgrade is 50%.

en\u0000Korshek's group includes several.text:
Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.

=== Skill recommendations ===

; Countering Searing Flames
There are several techniques to effectively counter Searing Flames:
* Bring skills that interrupt or inflict Dazed.
* Use Frigid Armor to prevent being set on fire. 
* Signet of Humility will prevent Searing Flames from being cast; Diversion will disable it for an extended period.
* The boss will quickly kill itself while hexed with either Pain Inverter or Spoil Victor.

; Other skills

* Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm will reduce the elemental damage.
* Winter converts all elemental damage to cold damage, which deals more damage to Ruby Djinns.
* Extinguish and Breath of the Great Dwarf remove Burning from all party members.
* Frozen Soil will prevent the Roaring Ethers from using Resurrection Signet.
* The ethers are the only fleshy foes in Korshek's group, so it does not help much to bring skills that cause Bleeding, Disease, or Poison; similarly, skills that exploit corpses are ineffective for this battle.
* Consider going to open the Do Not Touch Treasure in Forum Highlands after killing Korshek the Immolated, which is near the boss' location.

en\u0000Head north through the Tahnnakai.text:
Head north through the Tahnnakai Temple explorable area from Zin Ku Corridor. Be prepared for area of effect fire damage from the Temple Guardians around him. If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Temple Guardians on your way to Quansong Spiritspeak. 

===Skill recommendations===
* You will not encounter any physical attackers, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here; however, Temple Guardians have Stun on Critical Hit.
* Quansong Spiritspeak and Temple Guardians are not fleshy creatures, so skills that exploit corpses and inflict bleeding, disease, or poison are ineffective against them.
* You will only encounter spellcaster mobs, so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the Temple Guardians (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, and Winnowing).
* Temple Guardians have less armor rating against cold damage, so consider bringing Winter or skills that deal cold damage. Consider bringing Water Magic hex spells that snare and deal cold damage (i.e. Deep Freeze, Ice Spikes, Mind Freeze, and Shard Storm), which will slow their movement speed and can help in preventing them from reaching your midline/backline and dealing point blank area of effect damage from Temple Guardians' Double Dragon and Quansong Spiritspeak's Ancestors' Rage.
* Temple Guardians have less armor rating against blunt damage, so consider using a weapon that deals blunt damage.

en\u0000The recommended way to reach Jed.text:
The recommended way to reach Jedeh is to start from the Mouth of Torment. Take the western exit to the Ruptured Heart and make your way to the portal to Crystal Overlook. There will be a few mobs of Graven Monoliths, Margonites and Giants to defeat or avoid. Once you reach the Overlook, the most direct route to Jedeh is indicated by the blue line on the map. However, this will take you through several groups of Djinn, who can be tough to fight especially in Hard Mode. An alternative that is more time-consuming but less lethal is to turn left after entering the map, and board a Junundu. Go through the sulfurous area in the middle of the map and approach Jedeh from the east rather than the northeast. All the mobs you meet along the way should be small and easily disposed of.

en\u0000The route from Cavalon doesn't r.text:
The route from Cavalon doesn't require you to fight Ssyn Coiled Grasp. Exit into the Archipelagos and head east, dispatching the first mob of fish that you encounter, then continue until you reach the edge of the map and head south. Now head for the boss, killing the patroling Naga and the two stationary Naga mobs in front of the boss. Engage and kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna to complete the bounty. 

If taking the route from Jade Flats (Luxon), your party will only encounter Naga Warriors, Naga Archers, Naga Ritualists, Ssyn Coiled Grasp, and a few Kappa. Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party does not contain any allies that require attacks and attack skills to deal damage, since your party will only encounter a total of two Kappas who use Blurred Vision and Shatterstone (whose end effect triggers even if the hex is removed). Consider not bringing blocking skills, since they can be bypassed by Naga Warriors and Archers. Naga Warriors and Archers can also interrupt with Distracting Blow and Concussion Shot, so consider skills that can prevent interrupts, inflict blind or cause misses. Consider Signet of Binding for Destruction spirits created by Naga Ritualists and Ssyn Coiled Grasp.

en\u0000Once a player gets in radar rang.text:
Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp. Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.

===Skill recommendations===
*If you go clockwise through its patrol path:
**You will only encounter spellcaster mobs (Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and Phantoms), so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Dark Flame Dryders use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
**The only physical attackers will be the Bone Minions created by the Flesh Golems via Animate Bone Minions, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.
*This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
*If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a Volcanic Rock.
*It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path

en\u0000If you follow the path in the th.text:
If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Marrow Scarabs, Minotaurs, Rockshot Devourers, and Scarab Nest Builders on your way to Kepkhet Marrowfeast. Hex removal skills are unnecessary, as the aforementioned foes do not cast hexes.

Avoid using condition-inflicting skills on Marrow Scarabs, as they will use Plague Touch and then Virulence. Marrow Scarabs use Well of the Profane, so either interrupt its activation, avoid bringing enchantments with long recharge times, and/or move away from corpses before they are exploited to create a Well of the Profane.

Rockshot Devourers and Scarab Nest Builders use Distracting Shot, so skills that block, inflict the blind condition, cause misses, or prevent interruption can be helpful. They also use numerous traps, so it may be a good idea to have one party member walk ahead of the party to trigger the traps and prevent the entire party from taking damage.

Sometimes Kepkhet Marrowfeast is hidden at first and won't popup until a party member approaches her spawn point. The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet Marrowfeast won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range, so you can cause Kepkhet Marrowfeast to deplete her energy by healing and protecting the Scarab Nest Builder prior to your party engaging Kepkhet Marrowfeast. When you go near Kepkhet Marrowfeast, several Marrow Scarabs will popup. If Kepkhet Marrowfeast casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity and remove Mark of Protection.
* Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Family Soul quest, since it also requires you to kill her.
